programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: The Killing Zone : In the 1990's the war on drugs was in full swing. The front lines were often America's inner cities where gangs use violence and murder to rule their empires.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: The World Trade Center Bombing : Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: The Crazy Don : To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: The Search For Lisa Rene : When a young woman was grabbed from her Texas home, the police raced to find her abductors. On the face of it, the kidnapping seemed like the random act of desperate men.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Crackdown : In the 1980s, the drug trade in New York City was a nightmare. Dealers made millions. Street violence was out of control. The NYPD battled the drug gangs only to become their target.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Dixie Mafia : On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a Judge and his politician wife are murdered in their home. The killer left few clues. It looked like a professional hit, and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI refused to give up.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Caught in the Act : Surveillance video is often the most precise witness to a crime. After three brutal murders were caught on tape in Alabama, the suspects fled the area. They had an arsenal of stolen weapons, and swore they wouldn't be taken alive.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Bitter End : In Las Vegas, a gang of robbers target an ATM repository and hit the jackpot. Their take was over a million dollars in cash, the largest heist in Las Vegas history.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Dead Run : In Pennsylvania, an inmate escaped with the help of his female accomplice. Following a trail of fraudulent credit card receipts and deaths, authorities track the pair, but always find themselves one step behind.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Vanished : A daring kidnapping and a bizarre ransom note baffled Mississippi authorities. The victim was the wife of a wealthy businessman. A list of 12 names and a few drops of blood were the only clues to her fate.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Inside The Bureau : In this special episode, we take a closer look at cases previously featured on this series. Our goal is to explore more fully some of the investigative methods and techniques that have made the FBI the premier law enforcement agency in the world.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Deadly Obsession : Power is a responsibility as well as a privilege. But in the wrong hands, power can corrupt. For former Deputy Attorney General for the State of Delaware, losing sight of his sworn oath to uphold justice could prove lethal.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Terror In Disguise : Banks use a variety of devices to discourage would-be robbers security cameras, silent alarms, and exploding dye packs. But when an elusive bank robber targeted Seattle's banks, none of these precautions were effective.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Deadly Influence : In the 1980's, thousands of violent criminals flooded into America from Cuba and Colombia. Drugs hit South Florida and the area bloated with illicit wealth became a violent powder keg.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Master Plan : Willow Springs, Illinois, seemed like any other quiet Midwestern community. But it was really one of the most corrupt places in the nation. This tiny village, nestled just outside of Chicago, was in the hip pocket of organized crime.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Rebellion in Paradise : In Puerto Rico, a band of extremists waged a guerrilla war against the United States. Their goal, to make the island an independent nation, or die trying.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Broken Trust : A New York homebuyer gets more than he bargained for when a house inspection turns up a mummified corpse. For decades, the crime had gone undiscovered. The victim unmissed, and the killer unpunished.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Web of Clues : Forensic Entomology: Bugs have roamed the earth for 250 million years, but their intimate association with death is just now coming to life.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: True Crime : They know as much about crime as any crime fighter, or any criminal. They're the crime writers, and through their eyes we see murder most foul.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Seeds of Destruction : Forensic Botany & Geology: Plants help provide oxygen and nutrients for existence. Soil is the fertilizer of life. Yet both can yield clues to the time and location of a person's death.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Face Of Tragedy : Forensic Sculpting: Forensic sculptors retrieve people from oblivion. Using clay and an intricate knowledge of anatomy, forensic arts place a face on an unidentified skull, recreating the victim's likeness, which often leads to his name.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Without A Trace : Missing Person: Approximately 1.8 million Americans are reported missing each year. Worldwide, the number of missing persons nearly triples.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Traces Of Guilt : Sometimes the scales of justice are balanced by just a few milligrams of evidence  a couple of fibers, a tooth filling, or a smudge on a piece of tape. The biggest cases are often solved by the smallest clues.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Loved To Death : A victim usually never foresees danger when the perpetrator turns out to be a friend or a lover. Science and microscopic evidence can unmask these killers and find justice for those who are Loved To Death.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Fatal Abduction : Anytime, anywhere, people disappear, kidnapped from their daily routines. Predators always leave clues behind, but chasing them takes time, hampering investigators' attempts to solve these fatal abductions.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Partners In Crime : They say that a burden shared is a burden halved, but when partners team up to commit murder, the weight of their guilt remains just as heavy. Investigators must rely on forensic science to capture partners in crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Elements Of Murder : There are several things that can suggest murder; jealousy, anger, poison! When everyday substances reveal hidden clues that break a homicide case, those substances become the elements of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Soldier Stories : This show profiles the work of world-renowned forensic experts as they work to tell the stories of the young men who went to war (from the French and Indian war to Vietnam) and never came back.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Fateful Twist : A southeastern Virginia community is stunned by a crime no one can believe. A pregnant woman murdered, her baby lost. Across the state, another town feels a similar shock, a brutal, random slaying in a most unexpected setting.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Trial By Fire : At a crime scene, anything left behind or seemingly out of place is considered a clue. But a fire can extinguish everything in its path, challenging forensic investigators at every turn and making each arson a trial by fire.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Deadly intentions : When abduction turns to murder, forensic science is the only key to finding justice for the victims of a kidnapper's deadly intentions.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Deadly Aim : Ballistic analysis is the key to finding killers who turn guns on their victims. Each shot fired leaves its own fingerprint, allowing scientists to target murderers with deadly aim.

programme.desc: What's that Sound? : Blue hears something that we can't hear, so we play Blue's Clues to figure out what it is. Led by our ears, we help Shovel and Pail follow the path a gopher took in the woods, based on the sounds he makes.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Signs : Guided by signs and symbols around the house, we play Blue's Clues to figure out where Blue wants to have her snack.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Hide and Seek : Steve and Blue are playing Hide and Seek and it's Blue's turn to hide. We play Blue's Clues to figure out where Blue wants to hide.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Animal Behavior : We play Blue's Clues to figure out what animal Blue wants to learn about. Throughout the episode, we learn about different animal behaviors by observing them and pretending to be them.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Occupations : All of our friends are pretending to be different occupations. We play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants to be. We help Steve, who is pretending to be a reporter, figure out what occupations our various friends are.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Anatomy : Steve discovers his heartbeat with a stethoscope -- and Blue has discovered something too. We play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue has discovered.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Pool Party : Oh no! It's a hot summer day and Blue and Steve are composing a list of friends to invite to our pool party, but there's someone we forgot to invite! We play Blue's Clues to figure out who's missing from our list.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Nature : We spend the entire episode outdoors enjoying nature and playing Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants to play. We identify herbs and help Mr. Salt and Paprika put together a bouquet, go on a walk, and play "I Spy."

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Inventions : We're playing Blues Clues because we want to know what Blue invented. Steve wants to invent something, too, but he keeps inventing things that already exist!

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: What's So Funny? : Something kind of silly's going on at Steve and Blue's house and we play Blue's Clues to figure out what makes Blue laugh.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Environments : Steve and Blue are going on a big trip! We play Blue's Clues to figure out where Blue wants to go. As we search for clues, we pack for our trip and learn about new environments.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Blue's Big Costume Party : It's Blue's costume party and lots of silly spooky things are happening! Magenta doesn't have a costume, so we play Blue's Clues to help her figure out what to wear.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Blue's Big Pajama Party : It's a special nighttime game of Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants to do tonight. As we search for clues we join Shovel and Pail for a game and learn about the animals who are awake while we are asleep.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Shy : Blue is feeling shy, so we play Blue's Clues to figure out what she is feeling shy about. Along the way, we meet Pail's friend Sifter and Miranda, who lives with Magenta. We help Shovel figure out how to play with Sifter.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Magenta Gets Glasses : Magenta Gets Glasses: It's a big day -- Magenta is getting glasses! We launch into a game of Blue's Clues to figure out what Magenta will be able to do when she gets her glasses.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Imagine Nation : Imagine Nation: With a shape made out of two chairs and a blanket, Steve is imagining there's an igloo in the living room! But Blue sees something different.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: The Anything Box : The Anything Box: Steve and Blue found an empty box in the backyard. They figure out that if we imagine, we can use the box to play rocket ship. We blast off -- and play Blue's Clues.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: A Brand New Game : Everyone is making up games today! Joe's made-up game is called Presto Change-Joe! Joe changes something about his appearance and we try to figure out what's different.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Blue's Big Band : Who's got rhythm? We all do! All of our friends are making music! What instrument is Blue going to play in Blue's Big Band?

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Playing Store : Today we're playing store! Our friends have set up pretend stores and preschoolers help Joe shop for everything on his is. We play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants to get at the store.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman adhère à la Nambla : Cartman en a marre des autres. Pour lui ils ne sont pas assez matures. Il décide de trouver des amis adultes sur Internet, mais tous ses amis se font envoyer en prison. Il va voir Mephesto pour avoir un ami artificiel.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Tampons en Cheveux de Cherok : Kyle tombe gravement malade, et en ville tout le monde ne jure que par la médecine à base de plantes des indiens. La mère de Kyle refuse alors de faire hospitaliser son fils croyant qu'il ira mieux avec les plantes.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Chef Pète les Plombs : Chef est scandalisé : le drapeau de South Park est selon lui raciste. Afin d'en juger avec la plus grande impartialité, il est demandé aux enfants de décider s'il faut changer ou non le drapeau.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Un Truc Qu'on Peut Faire Avec le Doigt : Cartman décide de mettre à exécution le rêve qu'il vient de faire : monter un groupe de musique avec les autres garçons pour gagner '10 millions de dollars'.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les handicapés vont-ils en enfer? : Le Pasteur décide de parler de l'enfer. Il fait alors peur aux enfants en leur disant que s'ils ne sont pas de bons chrétiens, ils périront dans les flammes de l'enfer. Les enfants, décident alors de devenir de bons chrétiens.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Probablement : Dans l'épisode précédent, les garçons découvrent le Pasteur en plein acte sexuel dans son église. Cartman décide de prendre les choses en main afin de remettre dans le droit chemin tous les enfants de la ville.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: CM1 : C'est la rentrée. Les garçons arrivent en CM1, heureux de ne plus se faire taper par les grands du CM1. Mais ce sont désormais les CM2 qui les tapent. La nouvelle prof Mme Chrokelpaf, ainsi que la nouvelle façon de travailler les effrayent.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le Super Classeur : Cartman vient d'acheter un tout nouveau classeur avec toutes les fonctionnalités. C'est alors qu'un homme venu du futur le prévient que ce classeur peut envahir la planète. Le classeur est donc détruit, mais Cartman s'en rachète un le lendemain.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Helen Keller! The Musical : Thanksgiving approche et comme tous les ans, les CM1 doivent jouer la vie d'Helene Keller. Butters s'est infiltré chez les maternelles et leur annonce que leur spectacle est superbe.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Camp de Régime : Cartman est envoyé en Camp de Régime car tous ses proches trouvent que c'est mauvais pour lui d'être gros. Il décide alors de tirer profit de cette expérience, mais pas de la manière dont ses proches le souhaiteraient.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le Mot en M : Les enfants veulent aller voir un concert, mais les parents de Kyle refusent de le laisser y aller. Kyle décide alors de trouver un moyen pour se débarrasser d'eux. Cartman lui conseille d'appeler la police et de dire qu'il se fait maltraiter.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le Cycle du Caca : Cette année, les garçons ont peur de ne pas avoir de cadeaux de Noël. Les gens n'achètent plus. Kyle décide alors d'aller voir Mr Hankey pour l'aider a redonner l'esprit de Noël.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Scott Tenorman doit mourir : Cartman voudrait être le premier de la bande à atteindre la puberté. Il achète donc des 'poils' 10 dollars à un garçon plus âgé, Scott Tenorman.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Y'en a Dans Le Ventilo : La série Cop Drama va diffuser un épisode ou le mot 'Merde' sera prononcé. Dès lors une épidémie de peste se déclare.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Combat d'Infirme : Al Super Gay est viré des scouts parce qu'il est gay. Et les enfants font la connaissance de Jimmy Valmer, un handicapé qui prend la vie avec humour. Mais Timmy est jaloux du succès de Jimmy, et un combat d'infirmes est engagé.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Terrance et Phillip : de tempêtes en naufrages : Terrence et Phillip, les canadiens pétomanes, mettent fin à leur duo pour divergences créatives. Les garçons se mettent en tête de réunir leurs idoles.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman Land : Suite à la mort de sa grand-mère, Cartman hérite d'un million de dollars et réalise son rêve de toujours: il achète un parc d'attraction (dont il profite tout seul) qu'il rebaptise 'Cartmanland '.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Du bon usage du preservatif : Les parents découvrent que leurs enfants sont très mal informés sur les choses du sexe. On demande à l'école de donner des cours. À croire que les parents ignorent qui sont les enseignants, Mme Crockelpaf, Mr Mackey et Mr Garrison.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Servietsky : À peine les enfants ont-ils obtenu leur console Gamesphère qu'on leur enlève. Ils doivent livrer une serviette intelligente fumant des pétards a une organisation militaire. Seulement les gamins se retrouvent embrouillés dans une histoire.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Oussama Ben Laden pue du cul : Kenny, Cartman, Stan et Kyle sont envoyés par erreur en Afghanistan. Sur place et contre toute attente, ils vont s'apercevoir qu'ils ont beaucoup de points communs avec les enfants Afghans.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Comment manger avec son cul : Cartman placarde la photo de Kenny associée à la mention 'Enfant disparu' sur tous les packs de lait du pays.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: L'Engin : Mr Garrison, ne supportant plus que ses vols d'avions soient annulés ou retardés, décide d'inventer un nouveau moyen de transport.Kyle est très embarrassé quand il reçoit la visite de son cousin de New-York, également prénommé Kyle.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les riches debarquent : Se sentant rejeté, Token décide d'appeler d'autres riches. Mais les hommes de la ville ne supportent pas l'arrivée de ces riches.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kenny Se Meurt : Cartman tente de sauver la vie de Kenny en suppliant le Congrès de faire reprendre la recherche sur les cellules souches.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: L'Episode de Butters : Butters fait quelques découvertes qui vont changer le cours de son existence. Son père est bisexuel et sa mère tente de le tuer. Heureusement tout s'arrange à la fin.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Couillo-mentonite : Le Maury Povich Show reçoit des personnes difformes et leur offre des cadeaux. Les gamins décident d'envoyer Butters au show avec des testicules en latex attachées au menton.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Asspen : Vacances à Aspen. Les gamins ont des ennuis avec des ados fous de ski et les parents vont vivre l'enfer de l'arnaque.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La bande-annonce du nouveau Terrance et Phillip : Le visionnage d'une bande annonce se transforme en course contre la montre pour trouver une télé valable.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le veau, c'est rigolo : Les enfants se soucient du sort des veaux qui sont en réalité des bébé vaches torturés.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Professeur Chaos : Butters est exclu du groupe des gamins. Excedé, il s'invente un alter-égo maléfique, le Professeur Chaos. Pendant ce temps, Stan, Cartman et Kyle mettent en place une sélection pour trouver un remplaçant à Kenny.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Noël au Canada : Les parents biologiques d'Ike reviennent le chercher chez les parents de Kyle.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les armes, c'est rigolo : Grâce à un stratagème surfait, les garçons obtiennent des armes ninja. Alors qu'ils jouent, ils blessent leur camarade Butters. Pris dans un dilemme draconien, les garçons décident de le déguiser en chien pour l'emmener chez le véterinaire.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Génial-O : Cartman s'habille comme un robot, s'auto-proclame 'Génial-O' et déménage chez Butters pour découvrir tous ses secrets et les utiliser contre lui.

programme.desc: Star Catcher : Excited, Dora puts the Star Pocket on Backpack and Dora and Boots set off on their very first star catching adventure. Their educational journey will take them all the way to the Cloud Castle, as they try to rescue an adorable baby star.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's First Trip : Dora tells the story of how she first met Boots. On their very first adventure, Dora and Boots have to bring instruments back to the Fiesta Trio so they can play for the cranky Queen Bee.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Star Mountain : Swiper swipes Dora's favorite necklace and flings it all the way to the top of Star Mountain! To get to the peak, Dora and Boots need to run up the Star Steps, climb up the Diamond, and make it through ice, wind, and snow!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: La Maestra de Musica : "Hola, hola!/ Hello, Hello!/ It's a great day for school/ You know!" Boots' music teacher, la maestra de música, needs to get to school in a hurry - but her bicycle is broken!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Daisy, La Quinceanera : It's Dora's cousin Daisy's 15th birthday party, her quinceañera! But the party can't start without Dora and Boots - they need to teach everybody the mambo!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Save Diego : Dora's cousin Diego protects and defends all the animals in the rainforest. But in order to save a Baby Condor, Diego winds up trapped himself. And now he needs OUR help! ¡No te preocupes, Diego!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Baby Jaguar's Roar : Oh no! Baby Jaguar's best friend, Baby Bear, is stuck on a ledge atop Bear Mountain - and the ledge is cracking! With Baby Jaguar leading the way, Dora, Boots, and Diego race to the rescue!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: A Crown for King BoBo : Dora and Boots set out to help King Juan el Bobo find his crown so we can all go to his Mamí's birthday party. Where did the forgetful king put his crown?

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's Got a Puppy : Abuela gives Dora and Boots a present for Dora's new puppy, but they'll have to watch out for Swiper, who's got a bunch of new swiping tricks up his sleeves.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Big Sister Dora : Dora has some really exciting news to tell us: Someone new is joining Dora's family! Someone who sleeps in a cradle, drinks from a bottle, wears diapers and likes to be rocked to sleep. Can you guess who it is? That's right!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's Pegaso Adventure : Dora and Boots hop on Pegaso, the flying horse constellation, for a high-flying adventure to bring home his constellation friends to the Moon before the Sun rises!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Happy Birthday, Super Babies! : Happy Birthday, Super Babies!: It's the Twins' 1st birthday and Dora reads them a very special Super Babies story. Once upon a time, there was a Cake-snatching Bear who stole all the cakes from the birthday boys and girls.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's Hair-Raising Adventure : Boots really wants to give his mommy a picture of himself for her birthday, but he's having a really bad hair day! Dora and Boots set out on a Hairy Quest: Boots is ready for his close-up!

programme.desc: Five Servos Of Doom : Unaware that he is being followed by the Elite Guard, Wasp heads to Earth to take his revenge on Bumblebee.

programme.title: Transformers: Animated
programme.desc: Predacons Rising : When Sentinel Prime successfully captures fugitive Decepticons, Prowl becomes suspicious.

programme.title: Transformers: Animated
programme.desc: Human Error, Part 1 : The Autobots and the Elite Guard pursue Wasp for their own agenda. However, Blackarachnia has Swoop capture Wasp in her latest attempt to rid herself of her organic half. This experiment goes awry and turns Wasp into Waspinator.

programme.title: Transformers: Animated
programme.desc: Human Error, Part 2 : On Christmas Eve, Optimus Prime patrols the city in search of Soundwave. With Porter C. Powell selling Soundwave action figures, Optimus is paranoid that the real Soundwave is out there.

programme.title: Transformers: Animated
programme.desc: Decepticon Air : It turns out that Soundwave has trapped the Autobots in a virtual reality. Now, Sari must free them before Soundwave completely turns them into Decepticons.

programme.title: Transformers: Animated
programme.desc: This Is Why I Hate Machines : In an effort to speed up their return to Cybertron, Sentinel Prime has Jazz pilot the Elite Guard ship through a space storm. The storm's energies reactivate Swindle, who frees his fellow Decepticon prisoners, and the group goes on to take over the ship.

programme.title: Transformers: Animated
programme.desc: Endgame, Part 1 : A TransWarp accident with the Space Bridge sends Ratchet and Captain Fanzone to Cybertron, where Sentinel Prime has the planet on high alert. They soon end up stumbling upon a plot by Shockwave to steal Omega Supreme's Access Codes from Arcee.

programme.title: Transformers: Animated
programme.desc: Endgame, Part 2 : The Autobots discover Omega Supreme's energy signal on the Moon. Rachet insists on going there right away to save him, but Prime refuses, knowing that they are too weak to fight Megatron.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: First Encounter : During the war on Cybertron, the Mini-Cons, mini-transformers who can be used as upgrades by their bigger brethren, crash lands on Earth. In present day, a group of children finds their ship by accident which brings the war to Earth.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Metamorphosis : Escaping from the confrontation between Bots and Cons, Alex, Rad and Carlos find the cargo hold of the Exodus underground and are adopted by three minicons. Retreating to the moon, the 'Cons make the wreck of the Exodus there their base.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Base : Alexis, Rad and Carlos introduce themselves to Optimus Prime, Hot Rod and First Aid, and get a condensed history of the conflict. Meanwhile, on the moon, Megatron plots to capture the minicons that are now appearing all over earth.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Comrade : The children join the Autobot team and head out on their first mission to find a newly waking minicon. The Decepticons arrive to combat them. Optimus Prime finds his old minicon partner.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Soldier : The next minicon alert is from Antarctica. Starscream retrieves the minicon, but has it stolen from him. Hot Shot learns a lesson in cooperation.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Jungle : The newest minicon activates in the middle of a forest: both sides fight for it, and the conflict sets the trees alight. The Autobots attempt to battle the blaze, while Starscream finally acquires his own minicon.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Carnival : Rad and Carlos smuggle their minicons out of the base to visit the town's carnival. Billy and Fred see them transform and try to capture one, but are thwarted by Hot Shot.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Palace : In an ancient palace deep beneath the Sahara another minicon is waking, but who will reach it first - the children or the Decepticon Demolishor?

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Confrontation : The Decepticons capture all the children to use as hostages in exchange for the Autobots's minicons. Fred and Billy are officially introduced to the Autobots.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Underground : The latest minicon re-activates in the subway system of a large city, and there's the usual scramble to see which side can get to it first. And a new transformer makes himself known - but which side is he on?

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Ruin : From an ancient submerged city a beautiful girl issues a warning about the devastating power - and danger - of three special, combining minicons. The Autobots already have two of them: now Megatron aims to capture the third.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Prehistory : The children learn more about the history of the minicons and the war. The latest minicon alert leads the team to a volcanic island: the volcano erupts in the middle of the usual 'Bot vs 'Con battle.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Swoop : he Decepticons gain access to the Autobot base, and attempt to take the other two minicons that, with the one Megatron captured on the island, combine to make the supremely powerful Star Sabre. Can Hot Shot save the day?

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Overmatch : Hot Shot proves himself very skilled with the Star Sabre, but the arrival of a new Decepticon proves him overconfident. The Decepticons acquire the first of another three combining minicons which transform into the ultimate form of defence.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Gale : A new minicon activates inside a highway tunnel, and the race is on to see who reach it first. Hot Shot is becoming more proficient with the Star Sabre. A new transformer arrives, claiming to be an Autobot, but Rad has his doubts.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Remorse : Hot Shot insists they should take vengeance on the Decepticons: Scavenger, with the support of the minicons, reminds him of their true purpose. With Hot Shot's realisation of the right way forward, Jetfire hands over command to him.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Depart : With the Autobot ship ready to leave, Hot Shot, supported by the rest of the team, refuse to let the children accompany them. But then the minicons refuse to allow the ship to depart unless the kids are on board.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Miracle : As the Axalon chases the Decepticon ship, hundreds of minicons appear. The 'Cons turn back to fight, and the 'Bots seem doomed, but the minicons resurrect Optimus.

programme.title: Ridiculousness

programme.title: Ridiculousness

programme.title: Ridiculousness

programme.title: Ridiculousness

programme.title: Ridiculousness

programme.title: Ridiculousness

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Big Black : Rob's former co-star Big Black joins the panel, breaking down Makeshift Thrill Rides, Bieber Hair, and Coming in Hot. See how human scorpions sting in a whole different way than the spider that attacks an innocent dad.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Travis Pastrana : Action sports star Travis Pastrana helps Rob illustrate some Poorly Placed Trees and Whiskey Throttles. Rob breaks down Pastranabees and Animals Being Human. Explode with laughter at an ill-fated Butt Bottle Rocket.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: The Dingo : Action sports personality The Dingo joins Rob in breaking down Pain Angels, Worst Case Scenarios and things That'll Cost You. And you'll never guess what happens when a heavy lifter loses control.

programme.title: Ridiculousness

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Jeff Tremaine : Producer Jeff Tremaine joins Rob in breaking down what it means to Lawnchair and Slam and Sprint. Some kids start slamming young in Ridiculousness in Training, and Rob points out Your Friend's a Dick.

programme.title: Ridiculousness

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Chris "Drama" Pfaff : Rob's cousin Drama helps Rob break down Family Dysfunction, Your Friend's a Dick, and Little Rollers. Credit Cards compete for pain against Popsicles. And learn whether Parkour is an art or just some Aggressive Running.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Judd Leffew : Bull rider Judd Leffew schools Chanel on whether bulls get dizzy when Rob breaks down A Bunch of Bull and Angry Animals. Watch fools compete in the Ridiculousness Decathlon. And a whole lot of people get Dunked.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Biker Fox : Caite Upton joins Steelo once again as Rob shows off S**t Whips and Redneck Good Times. A lot of people blow out their money-makers in De-Faced. Biker Fox joins the panel for some fun in spandex and scrapes in Biker Down.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Ryan Dunn : TV star Ryan Dunn joins the fun as Rob points out the problems with Lower Education. See some folks who are clearly Out of Your League while others get slammed in That's What You Get and Let Me Help You Hurt Yourself.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Dan Heaton : Rob breaks down Why Rollerblading Should Make a Comeback. Witness a merry-go-round of pain in Worst Case Scenario, Almost Made It and Not Even Close. And guest unicyclist Dan Heaton shows off some Uni-Psychos.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Dana White : This week on an all-new episode of Ridiculousness: Rob Dyrdek and UFC President Dana White show us the meaning behind "Banned-Kinis" and go head-to-head with today's most volatile "Hot Heads".

programme.title: Counting Cars

programme.title: Counting Cars
programme.desc: The Car Hoarder : Danny can't stop buying cars. Soon after striking a deal on Gordon's '73 Mustang, he finds an enormous FMC Motorhome, and then ends up in a heated roadside bidding war with Rick Harrison over an extremely rare "thing."

programme.title: Counting Cars
programme.desc: Van Haulin : Danny helps Shannon restore an old VW van and later finds a '69 Ford Bronco for a single mom who wants to revisit her youth with her son.

programme.title: Counting Cars
programme.desc: Electric Ride : Pawn Stars' Old Man Mr. Harrison stops by Count's Kustoms with a job that is as unique and old-fashioned as he is. Later, the guys aren't in love with Roli's new special custom project.

programme.title: Counting Cars
programme.desc: Ghost Rider : An eccentric couple wants to turn a 20 year-old ambulance into a ghost-hunting vehicle, which awakens a rogue spirit in the shop.

programme.title: Counting Cars
programme.desc: School of Rick : The Count takes a chance by building a low-rider with a Count's Kustoms twist. Will the local aficionados embrace Danny's car, or kick it to the curb?

programme.title: Counting Cars
programme.desc: Pimp My Bus : Kevin disapproves of how much money Danny is spending tricking out his dream FMC Motorhome, but Danny has a surprise plan to help him get over it.

programme.title: Counting Cars
programme.desc: Quadzilla : Danny and Kevin visit mad mechanic Gordon to see his latest insane creation. Meanwhile, Danny shakes the rust off a '34 Ford and tries to turn it into a white hot-hot rod, completely engulfed in flames.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Tough Act to Follow : For years, Rich and Kathy tried to get their 1951 Buick Super back on the road. It’s now up to FantomWorks to succeed where four other shops failed. Dan has to solve the mystery of Jim’s classic 1961 Corvette and determine if the car needs major surgery.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Beast Mode : FantomWorks dives into prototype hell to give Nick a superfast 1969 Chevrolet Chevelle with an LT4 engine. Barlen wants his mother’s 1957 Chevrolet Bel Air to run like a dream for her birthday. Unfortunately, her birthday is in 30 days.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: If it Sprays, It Stays : Dan agrees to fix a 1947 Mack Firetruck that take FantomWorks into wet and uncharted territory. Ken’s 1971 Malibu Chevelle arrives as a garage ornament that hasn't run in five years, so it’s up to FantomWorks to bring this family heirloom back to life.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: All Revved Up : Nick challenges Dan to build a 1969 Camaro Pace Car that can beat the fastest Chevelle that FantomWorks has ever built. Pete’s Mustang Convertible was in three different shops, but it arrives with far more problems than anyone was expecting.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Sole Survivor : Ben wants a partial restoration for his father’s 1962 Maserati, but Dan sees only one solution – turning this heirloom into one of the rarest survivor cars on earth. Raymond and Diane only want one thing for their worn out 1966 bug – perfection.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: One Salty Shelby : Dennis has always dreamed of owning the bright orange 1970 Shelby GT500 that kicked his ass in a drag race. Returning customer Rikk wants to get his rare 1970 Chrysler 300 Hurst in shape. But the car is plagued by a mystifying list of gremlins.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: One Tough Customer : Robby wants to convert a 1926 Ford Model T to a far rarer 1914 C Cab. Dan agrees to the plan, but soon has cause to regret it. Anthony buys a 69 Chevrolet Camaro Convertible, but the car of his dreams is an accident waiting to happen.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Night Prowler : Brothers Jacob and Paul’s 1965 Chevy Impala nicknamed the Night Prowler would have been better named the Night Slug. Don shows up with a 1967 Corvette and a massive list of work that he wants done. Dan doesn’t know which is worse: the list, or the car.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Beauty and the Bee : When Ovide purchased his 1957 Bel Air sight unseen, the car was a rusted piece of junk so it’s on Dan to figure out how to restore this classic. Dino loves to go fast. His 1969 Super Bee is anything but super. Dan is tasked to feed Dino’s need for speed.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Rags to Riches : Nick bought his wife Danielle a 1953 Chevy Pickup for her 28th birthday. The couple wants a perfect FantomWorks restoration. The truck has other ideas. Eric’s rare 1939 LaSalle is a sight to behold, but it hasn’t seen a wrench in eighty years.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the E.R.
programme.desc: How Can This Happen : See what happens when neurosurgeon Dr. Smith is under extreme pressure when a young boy punctures his skull with a pitchfork.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the E.R.
programme.desc: Call The Code : A 21-year-old man has suffered internal injuries in a motorcycle accident. It's up to Dr. William Shillinglaw to save him from bleeding to death.

programme.title: Counting Cars
programme.desc: Horseplay : A high wire performer wants Danny to build a bike to commemorate his career and the records he has broken, and an Extreme Cowboy Racer wants the world's coolest trailer tricked out for her racing partner, Honey the Horse.

programme.title: Counting Cars
programme.desc: Mercury Rising : Danny lets painter Ryan take the lead on a 1959 Chevy Panel Truck project he hopes to flip, and later motivates his crew to clean up the shop with an inter-departmental build competition.

programme.title: Counting Cars
programme.desc: Rocked and Loaded : Country rocker Andy Ross wants Danny to build the world's most patriotic muscle car ever made. Will a Second Amendment-inspired hot rod Corvette do the trick? Meanwhile, Roli blackmails Horny Mike into teaching him how to airbrush.
